source_header: Catalogo de sismos - Servicio Sismologico Nacional (SSN) | UNAM - Mexico. DOI: 10.21766/SSNMX/EC/MX
Informacion sujeta a cambios. Archivo generado el 2026-11-06 a las 13:57:07 (tiempo del centro de Mexico).
Sismicidad del 1900-01-01 al 2026-11-06 (UTC), todas las magnitudes, todas las profundidades, en todo el pais.
source_footer: Fecha y hora local en tiempo del centro de Mexico. Coordenadas geograficas (latitud y longitud) del epicentro en grados decimales. Profundidad en kilometros.
La localizacion es solo una referencia a una localidad importante en cuanto a numero de habitantes y cercana al epicentro.
Los registros con estatus verificado son los calculados y publicados de manera oportuna por al menos un analista de sismogramas.
Los registros obtienen estatus revisado cuando se realiza un analisis, de ser posible, con mas y mejores datos para el calculo de parametros y cuyo tiempo de publicacion es variable.

Esta informacion puede ser reproducida con fines no lucrativos siempre y cuando se mencione como fuente al Servicio Sismologico Nacional. De otra forma, requiere permiso previo por escrito de la institucion.
Consulta nuestro Aviso Legal y Terminos de Uso en: www.ssn.unam.mx/aviso-legal
www.ssn.unam.mx | contacto@sismologico.unam.mx | 5622 2222 ext. 38706 (reportes de sismicidad), 38700 y 38701 (area administrativa).

query.geography: Source-declared national catalogue; not a territorial assignment.

source_timing.evidence_kind: Filesystem last-write metadata of the human-downloaded file; no original HTTP response captured.
source_timing.interpretation: Header and native local/UTC values are preserved. Later local origin times are flagged, not repaired. No trusted publication/acquisition clock or atomic catalogue capture is inferred.

selection.time_validation: Strict native UTC columns and declared query interval.

identifier_derivation.recipe: ssn-local- + first24hex(SHA256(UTF-8 compact JSON array of all ten original CSV cells)) + '-' + occurrence number of that exact cell array in source order, before selection
identifier_derivation.meaning: A deterministic local record key, not an original SSN ID or proof of a unique physical earthquake.

coverage_period.meaning: First/last selected reported origin; not acquisition time or proof of completeness.

field_semantics.status: Literal SSN verificado/revisado field; not a revision archive or update timestamp.
field_semantics.source_record: One-based data-row ordinal after the five header records, before selection.
field_semantics.place: Unchanged reference to a nearby locality, not a state/country/tectonic-zone assignment.
field_semantics.depth: Reported km, explicitly documented in the source footer; zero remains an observed zero.

transformations: Decode UTF-8 without modifying preserved source bytes.
Combine explicitly labelled UTC date/time into ISO8601Z; preserve native date/time and local strings.
Parse finite numeric magnitude, coordinates and depth; retain original magnitude/depth strings.
Select reported M>=3.5 with valid UTC and map coordinates; preserve all other records in the raw CSV.
Derive local row keys from all ten original cells and occurrence; retain duplicates if present.
Keep absent magnitude type, event type, authors, errors and update timestamp null.

limits: One current-catalogue download, not a public-catalogue historical replay or retained revision archive.
No source event IDs or magnitude-type column is supplied; local keys are not original SSN IDs and M is not silently labelled Mw/Richter.
Unreported uncertainties/authors/types/updates remain null, not zero or inferred contributor codes.
The 2026 calendar year is partial. Missing source years are not physical zero-event years; no arbitrary completeness year is chosen.
Reference localities do not establish territorial or tectonic membership; offshore/surrounding coordinates remain unchanged.
A distinct distributor does not prove observational independence from ComCat or other catalogues.
Counts describe selected source records and are not earthquake probabilities, ground-motion hazard or damage estimates.
The original three catalogues and their six data/manifest hashes remain unchanged.
